meta.titulo: Used Porsche 993 for sale · Valentín Motors
meta.descripcion: Porsche 911 type 993, the last air-cooled one, from 1994 to 1998. Inspected on 111 points, with a twelve-month warranty and certified mileage.

parrafos: The 993 is the last air-cooled 911, and the market knows it. A 3.6 engine with 272 hp, 285 with VarioRam from 1996, six-speed manual gearbox, multi-link rear suspension and a body many consider the best balanced of all. The Turbo introduces twin turbos and four-wheel drive; Carrera S and 4S wear its wide body.
It is a car that can be used every day and that appreciates. Cars with full history and no corrosion are the ones that set the price; the rest sell for less, and rightly so.

secciones.titulo: What we check on a 993 before selling it
items: Valve guides and oil consumption: the engine's weak point. We measure compression and leak-down.
Leaks at valve covers, seals and oil cooler. Condition of the front radiators and fans.
Multi-link rear suspension: bushes and arms, which show up as noises and in the alignment.
Six-speed gearbox and clutch; on the Turbo, both turbos and the four-wheel-drive system.
Body: repaired damage, original paint and match with the Porsche certificate.

parrafos: Every Porsche 993 we sell goes through our 111-point inspection, leaves with a twelve-month or 10,000 km warranty on engine and gearbox, and its certified mileage is stated on the sales invoice. We have been Porsche specialists since 1979, with our own workshops in Barcelona and Madrid: the car you buy here has been on our lift before it reaches your hands.
If you have found the one you want elsewhere, we can also check it for you before you pay for it: pre-purchase inspection.
